NONE: › to make a quick short note of something
› not at all or not even a small amount

example: Could you jot your address and phone number in my address book?
你能在我的通訊錄裡留下你的地址和電話嗎？
Don't listen to her! There's not a jot of truth (= there is no truth) in what she's saying.
別聽她的！她沒有一句實話。
None of the committee's proposals will matter a jot (= they will not matter) if no one reads their report.
如果沒人讀委員會的報告，他們的建議就一點用也沒有。

NONE: › to write something quickly on a piece of paper so that you remember it

example: I carry a notebook so that I can jot down any ideas.
我隨身帶了個筆記本，這樣可以把想法隨手記下來。

NONE: › a small book used for making notes in
匆匆記下的東西；筆記；便條

example: She made some jottings in the margin of the book she was reading.
她在所讀的書的頁邊空白處作了些筆記。
